data.name: Sustained Inspirational Expertise
data.description: When granting a bonus to allies via the inspirational expertise investigator talent (Advanced Class Guide 33), the investigator can spend one use of inspiration as a swift action the following round to extend the duration of the granted bonus for 1 additional round. The insight bonus granted decreases by 1 each round this ability is used.
